record.question: Which country was earlier known as Ceylon?
record.explanation: Answer D: Sri Lanka. Ceylon is the former name of Sri Lanka. The Sri Lanka National Archives explains that the 1972 constitution renamed Ceylon as Sri Lanka. Reference: https://archives.gov.lk/English/online-exhibits/path-to-freedom/republic. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
